occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children's names and ages: Caregivers could not give accurate ages of the oldest and youngest children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children's names and ages (26 TAC §744.1205(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records: Director did not have individual training certificates for employees.  Training was  completed but only the seminar attendance list was available.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records (26 TAC §744.801(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available -  Safety Documentation for Emergency Drills, Fire Extinguishers, and Smoke Detectors: Operation did not have current emergency drill/fire extinguisher/ smoke detector checklists.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available -  Safety Documentation for Emergency Drills, Fire Extinguishers, and Smoke Detectors (26 TAC §744.801(9))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Sanitation Inspection Report: Operation did not have a current food inspection sanitation report.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Sanitation Inspection Report (26 TAC §744.801(11))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Records: Childrens records were not available in english, were not translated from chinese.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Records (26 TAC §744.801(1))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training-Required Topics in Health and Safety: 3 staff still have not completed trainings in the following topics:    Handling, Storing and Disposing Hazardous Materials  Responding to Food Allergies  Preventing the Spread of Communicable Diseases  Understanding Building and Physical Premises Safety
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training-Required Topics in Health and Safety (26 TAC §744.1309(d))

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Plan-Emergency plan for diagnosed child, signed by health care professional and parent: Food Allergy Emergency Plans were not available for review for 4 children with documented food allergies.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Plan-Emergency plan for diagnosed child, signed by health care professional and parent (26 TAC §744.2669)

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records - Signed Statement from Parent: A signed statement from the parent stating their child's immunization record is on file at the school they attend was not available to review for 4 children's records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records - Signed Statement from Parent (26 TAC §744.623(1))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training-Required Topics in Health and Safety: 3 out of 4 staff files evaluated did not contain trainings in the following topics:    Emergency Preparedness  Handling, Storing and Disposing Hazardous Materials  Responding to Food Allergies  Preventing the Spread of Communicable Diseases  Understanding Building and Physical Premises Safety
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training-Required Topics in Health and Safety (26 TAC §744.1309(d))

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit Incomplete - Scissors: The first aid kit did not contain any scissors.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit Incomplete - Scissors (26 TAC §744.2753(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information-Emergency Medical Authorization: Authorization for emergency medical treatment was incomplete for 1 out 4 children's files evaluated.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information-Emergency Medical Authorization (26 TAC §744.605(12))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available -  Safety Documentation for Emergency Drills, Fire Extinguishers, and Smoke Detectors: Documentation showing the emergency drills were conducted monthly was not available for review. There was no documentation showing the smoke detectors and fire extinguishers were checked monthly.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available -  Safety Documentation for Emergency Drills, Fire Extinguishers, and Smoke Detectors (26 TAC §744.801(9))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Fire Inspection Report, Including Written Approval for Above/Below Ground Level Care: Documentation showing the annual fire inspection has been conducted was not available for review upon request.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Fire Inspection Report, Including Written Approval for Above/Below Ground Level Care (26 TAC §744.801(10))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: 4 out of the 10 children?s files evaluated did not contain the address for the emergency contact person.     3 out of the 10 children?s files evaluated did not contain the name and phone # for the release contact person.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §744.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Policies Comply with Rules: The operational policies still do not include the following information:    - Procedures for how parents can access minimum standards.  - Instructions on how parents can contact CCR and access abuse and neglect information.  - A plan to ensure physical activity occurs on days when extreme weather conditions prohibit or limit outdoor play.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Policies Comply with Rules (26 TAC §744.201(1))

occurrences.finding: Training Criteria - Certificate: 2 out of 10 staff files evaluated did not contain training certificate for completion of CPR and First Aid Training.    3 out of 10 staff files evaluated did not contain training certificates that show the full 15 hours of annual training has been completed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Criteria - Certificate (26 TAC §744.1319(c)(4))

occurrences.finding: Education Outside of U.S.: 8 out of 10 staff files evaluated contained education documentation written in a foreign language and has not been translated to English.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Education Outside of U.S. (26 TAC §744.1043)

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: Documentation of 10 staff files were not available for review upon request. The operation did not have any completed files.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §744.901)

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for -Transportation, Directors and Each Employee who transports: The Operation Director has only completed 1 hour of transportation safety training. An additional hour of training is needed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for -Transportation, Directors and Each Employee who transports (26 TAC §744.1301(7)(A))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: Admission information for 10 out of 10 children's files evaluated was not available for review upon request during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §744.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Policies Comply with Rules: The operational policies do not include the following information:    Transportation Policy  Procedures for how parents can view the operation most recent licensing inspection report and access minimum standards  Instructions on how parents can contact CCR and access abuse and neglect information.  (A)The benefits of physical activity and outdoor play   (B)The duration of physical activity at your operation, both indoor and outdoor  (C)The type of physical activity (structured and unstructured) that children may engage in at your operation  (D) Each setting in which your physical activity program will take place  (F) A plan to ensure physical activity occurs on days when extreme weather conditions prohibit or limit outdoor play.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Policies Comply with Rules (26 TAC §744.201(1))

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: The annual sanitation inspection has not been conducted since May 2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §744.2501(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available -  Safety Documentation for Emergency Drills, Fire Extinguishers, and Smoke Detectors: Documentation showing when the emergency drills were last conducted and when the smoke detectors and fire extinguishers were last checked was not available for review upon request.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available -  Safety Documentation for Emergency Drills, Fire Extinguishers, and Smoke Detectors (26 TAC §744.801(9))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Sign-in and Sign-out Logs: Children in Room 107 had not been signed in for the day.     Note: The provider corrected this during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Sign-in and Sign-out Logs (26 TAC §744.603(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The annual fire inspection has not been conducted since May 2021.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §744.3501(a))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers- Supervision of Children: During this inspection I observed two children ages 11 and 12 years old alone in a classroom.     During this inspection I observed a group of seven children unsupervised in the gym.     During this inspection I observed a 9 year old alone in a classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers- Supervision of Children (26 TAC §744.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Sign-in and Sign-out Tracking System: The sign in and out log was reviewed and showed 34 of 41 children signed in.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sign-in and Sign-out Tracking System (26 TAC §744.627(a))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The most recent fire inspection report was not available for review during this inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §744.3501(a))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Group Responsible For: Three caregivers were unaware of the number of children present during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Group Responsible For (26 TAC §744.1203(2))
